text:
jamal: flagging a mismatch between reserved GPU forecast and cloud billing for us-west-2. forecast shows ~9k reserved hours for the window, billing export shows ~11.2k. this is a material delta, can we triage?
olivia: :eyes: i noticed something weird in last week's tagged export — a handful of reservations lost owner labels around the 12th.
alex: finance-bot showed a cost uptick yesterday, might be related. any chance autoscale or onboarding scripts created untagged instances?
sre-bot: alert: capacity_headroom < 0 in us-west-2 on 2026-03-15 03:12 UTC (auto-detected). Related reservations: rsv-442, rsv-117.
maria: could be the nightly retrain batch that got moved to shared pool — anyone change the cron?
kevin: i touched the training job spec last week to change resourceClass -> "dedicated-training" to improve QoS. it should still pick the dedicated pool but i'll double-check selectors.
jamal: can someone run a quick billing->reservation join to map reservation ids to tags and instances? here's a starter query we used before:
```sql
SELECT reservation_id, SUM(hours) as hrs, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tag_owner) as owners
FROM `billing.gpu_usage_v2`
WHERE region='us-west-2' AND date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY reservation_id
ORDER BY hrs DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
olivia: running now, will paste top offenders when the job finishes.
olivia: quick paste of top row: rsv-442 -> hrs=2100, owners=NULL, linked_instances=15 (approx). looks like owner label stripped.
maria: owner=NULL explains why forecast tooling didn't attribute these to reserved commitments — they fell into hosted billing path. autoscale might create ephemeral instances without labels on race.
kevin: i can add a temporary tag back using gcloud and patch the k8s job to set labels. example command: 
```
# add label to instance group / instance
gcloud compute instances add-tags rsv-442-instance-01 --tags=owner:ml-team --zone=us-west2-b
```
jamal: finance-bot, can you queue a chargeback export broken down by reservation_id + instance_label for the last 30 days? need to confirm dollar delta.
finance-bot: export queued (id: exp-1758001234). ETA ~20m. download: https://finance.internal/exports/exp-1758001234.csv
jamal: plan proposal: 1) get the export and compute $ delta, 2) block or reject instance creations without reservation tags (short-term admission controller), 3) patch k8s job selectors and add a watch for untagged reservation hours > 1% of region usage. owners: olivia/kevin.
sre-bot: operational recommendation: create routing rule to send all `dedicated-training` workload labels to `dedicated-training-pool` and add a hard admission check for label presence.
alex: +1 on admission check. also propose an alert: if reservation_id.owner is NULL for > 5% of reserved hours in a day, page infra-oncall.
jamal: good. olivia, kevin — can you confirm ETA?
olivia: copying export link to channel when ready, will open PR for admission controller within 2h.
kevin: I'll patch the job specs and roll out change to training namespace, ETA ~3h.
maria: leaving note for next oncall — if cost delta > $5k consider a short postmortem and cost recovery plan.
jamal: thanks everyone :raised_hands: . i'll follow up after we have the export and the admitted-tag watch in place.
